Both at chest/shoulder height ✓ (0.762, 0.780 — backrest rail height), both forward of torso ✓ (z=0.486, 0.260 both positive), both on figure's right side ✓ (x=0.479, 0.608 — in front of twisted body where chair back is), 0.261 apart ✓ within 0.30 threshold.
